data.one_liner: Capture and crop document images with a customizable camera interface and edge detection.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter widget for scanning, cropping, and extracting text from physical documents. Features live camera preview, edge detection, perspective correction, on-device OCR, and multiple export formats.
use_when: You need to scan physical documents or IDs with edge detection.
You want on-device OCR without external API dependencies.
avoid_when: You require non-Latin OCR support like Arabic.
You need basic barcode or QR scanning instead of full document capture.
strengths: Offline-first with zero external network calls.
Supports multiple UI modes including native CamScanner delegation.
Multiple export formats including JPG, PNG, PDF, and TIFF.
weaknesses: Requires specific Android SDK versions (minSdk 24, compileSdk 36).
data.setup_notes: Requires Android compileSdk 36 and minSdk 24 for the camera implementation.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you primarily need QR and barcode scanning rather than full document capture and perspective correction.

alternatives.name: camera
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need low-level custom camera controls rather than a pre-built document scanning UI.
